fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-22
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-21 11:30 to 2026-10-22 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one, still open. Record: bf4a5af5 (proposed, filed 10-22 00:14).
- Fact: you ruled on srs-rust#1264 that diagnostics get stable codes. Today about 16 command results report problems as plain text lines; adding a code and severity means turning those lines into objects.
- Why it matters: every current reader (srs-web, srs-vscode, scripts, MCP clients) would break on the day the new build is pinned, the same silent break srs-rust#1132 showed. srs-web#441 waits on it.
- Options: (A) replace the text lists everywhere in one release: one spelling, breaks all readers at once. (B) add a structured list beside the text list, retire the text one later: nothing breaks, two lists for a while. (C) code on validation results only, other surfaces later: smallest and safest, delays render/find consumers. (D) do nothing: srs-web keeps grouping on message text.
- Recommendation: C first, then B for the remaining surfaces. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium, nothing is broken meanwhile.
Still waiting on you, unchanged: srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP), srs-rust#683 (MCP multi-repo, parked), srs-rust#1198 (catalog cache, needs SP-78 ranked), srs#236 (history note you asked for; no run has picked it up).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group; the builder filed no proposed decisions. Owner rulings this cycle, from the log: bbb03bff (srs-rust#1417: a new data-model revision lands in one change with its migration; in both logs). Your 11:10 session also ratified 7ee8fa01 (a decision is shown with its compass) and f58db200 (meaning in the definition over meaning in the surface).

3. Done: 3 delegated PRs merged with a quorum line, 6 more merged by you without one (owner-merge or human builder).
- srs-rust#1428 (read any instance through one call): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-9ee14517, approve.
- srs-rust#1427 (real error codes for CLI-local and binding failures): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-b2ff7c91 + ADR-053, approve.
- srs-rust#1426 (relation diagnostics, Invariant 20): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate 00567bf1, approve.
- srs-rust#1425 (dogfooding docs drop sourceDocumentIndex): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / RFC-038 [R25], approve.
- srs-web#600 (ADR-026 nav order): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / RFC-043, approve.
- srs-vscode#146 (payload schema sync): agent:tpr-builder / agent:tpr-reviewer / ADR-011, approve.
- Without a quorum line: srs-rust#1433, #1434 (RFC-051 PRs 1 and 2) and #1437 (RFC-052 PR 1a), merged by you. #1433 carries my reject (merge conflict) and was merged afterwards.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs: srs-rust#1438 (RFC-051 write sets, human builder, no review yet) and srs-vscode#145 (section order from entry order, reviewer rejected: check-payload-schema-drift red, migrate-packet.json missing; srs-vscode#146 merged since, so it should clear on a re-run or update-branch). needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1264, srs#236. srs-rust#1417 is claimed by you as builder (branch 1417-rev10-root-container).

5. Budget: 6 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 2 open. Pause state: running (the 10-21 report carries a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: bf4a5af5 is the one proposed record in the group log (an escalation, about 12 hours old). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and not stopped: 2 (srs-rust#1417, claimed by you; srs-rust#1132, P2). Top of the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs-rust#1417, srs-rust#1132. Open group PRs in flight: 2. Budget left: 4 this cycle. Queue running dry: 2 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: new work could come from the analyst's nominations, the spec-to-implementation drift list, the open exercise below, and unblocking the needs-input items above. Waiting on you: bf4a5af5 and the four items in section 1. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-20 late run: filed 0, nominated 8 (promote:ready on existing issues); no run since.

6b. Exercises: one open, the group's own (not listed in the SemanticOps log): "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable: RFC-038 [R7]+[R24] against rfc-decision-2e0cd70a" (2ac083c0). Input asked for: should an out-of-contract top-level key be a non-fatal diagnostic, or is fail-closed right and the LOAD verb narrowed to `meta`.

7. What we learned: the agent builder plus reviewer loop delivered six merges in a day with a quorum line each, but the owner merged the larger spec-driven PRs by hand, so the budget figure understates the day's throughput. An escalation raised overnight (bf4a5af5) waited 12 hours with no route that surfaces it before the next report; the report is the only place it appears. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is still ready to unpark; flagged again.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: the only item outside the boundary this cycle, srs-rust#1264 diagnostics shape, already has an open proposed record (bf4a5af5), so no second record was filed. The RFC-052 escalation (bbb03bff) was ruled by the owner.
